observations.contract: Grip scale admission and physical output
observations.trace: Consider a single component with id grip, shape Grip, length0.1 m, radius0.01 m, both explicit end scales0, no wraps, no shaft or opposition, and one attachment to weapon.root at the base. All numeric values are finite, the recipe and component counts are small, positive nominal dimensions pass, scales satisfy the absolute and upper anatomical limits, and the other selected shape checks do not add a grip scale condition. Placement inserts weapon.root, resolves the base anchor and finds no parent component or implicit shaft for the contact check. The frame range is [0,0.1], within the world bound. Grip construction sends two zero radii to lathe; its profile, segment and radial-scale guards pass, the bounded subdivision can proceed, and neither side nor cap emits a triangle. Physical integration then has mass0 and first moment0, so 1/mass is infinite and component and total center of mass evaluate as 0 times infinity (NaN). GeneratedModel from an empty position list retains +/-infinite extrema and nonfinite dimensions. Public generate_model and validate reach this construction path.
observations.remaining: This is a symbolic source-level counterexample, not an executed recipe, generated model, parser, test or gameplay observation. The original Adler335 finding retains its original reviewer and scope; ordinary catalog reachability, other possible producers, positive-pole policy, output consumers and global aliases remain open. Avoid rejecting legitimate single-end poles or all distinct legitimate geometric defaults without a policy decision.

observations.trace: RecipeError is a typed classification, but Construction::new maps it to String and returns String; public ValidationError::Construction stores the resulting String. Codec encode validates before serializing, while decode parses with MAX_ENCODED_RECIPE_BYTES before validating. Recipe::validate separately caps serialized recipe bytes at65536 and catalog identity length at128.
observations.remaining: No encoder, decoder, serializer, geometry or error path ran. The observed differing bound locations alone do not prove a valid encoded envelope exceeds the decode cap. Complete envelope-size accounting and actual producer, consumer and error-alias policies remain open.

observations.trace: adaptive_curve refines at most eight levels per initial interval and pushes an endpoint at the depth limit even if requested chord or deviation is still exceeded. Its infinite default thresholds mean minimum-segment mode. The separate rational-surface algorithm documents quadratic-over-positive-affine height preconditions, checks midpoint deviation, truncates new points on a budget error, and can return an error after its bounded rounds. split_edges counts immutable present midpoint options before matching and unwraps only positions implied by the count.
observations.remaining: Neither a supported authored curve whose accepted result exceeds a required quality contract nor an invalid ordinary callback producer is established. These are different algorithms, not grounds to claim every mesh publishes an unmet bound or that a normal path panics. Outside-test unwrap style remains separately relevant; no geometry computation or test ran.

observations.trace: maximum_edge and maximum_deviation in the refinement API and Detail::error are geometric distance controls represented as raw f64. The existing recipe::Metres owns finite signed distances; it supplies an owner fit for units but does not itself require positive tolerances.
observations.remaining: Retain precision and intentional infinite/default numerical modes where actually needed; a positive local refinement policy and caller-by-caller native boundary must be decided separately. Historical root Lens2 evidence is not Lens1 or other-lens coverage.
